'''Earwin''' is a member of the [[Children of the Light]].

==Appearance==
He is large and has gray eyes and a long mustache.

==Activities==
On arrival to the [[Almoth Plain]], [[Geofram Bornhald]] was forced to relinquish some of his men, including Child Earwin, to take orders from the [[Questioner]]s.

Later, Earwin took part in the terrorizing of one of the villages on Almoth Plain, hanging around thirty men, women, and children while disguised as [[Taraboner]]s. Bornhald rightly finds these actions disgusting and shocking.
